summary: Backend-only regression verification for the admin product edit/save bug fix (frontend `makeStyles` TDZ reorder in /app/frontend/app/admin.tsx). Backend was NOT touched by the fix; this iteration re-ran the full existing regression suite (45 tests across 3 files) to confirm no backend behavior drifted. All 45/45 PASS in 10.32s. Coverage already in place and re-verified: (1) PUT /api/admin/products/{id} with full ProductUpsertRequest body — persists every field (name, tagline, description, price, image, category, benefits, ingredients, in_stock) + avg_rating/rating_count still computed; (2) POST /api/admin/products auto-generates p_<hex> id, appears in GET /api/products; (3) DELETE /api/admin/products/{id} removes and GET returns 404; (4) /api/admin/categories ADD / PUT rename cascades across products / DELETE from managed list; (5) Admin auth gating: 401 (no token), 403 (non-admin), 200 (admin) across GET/POST/PUT/DELETE on /admin/categories and /admin/products; (6) Public /api/products, /api/products/categories (prefixed with 'All'), /api/orders/me, /api/orders/create (razorpay + UPI), /api/support/info, /api/admin/orders all unchanged and green. Verdict: frontend fix is isolated — no backend regression.

Returns 200 even when product does not exist (idempotent, inconsistent with other DELETEs that 404; pre-existing).
N+1 aggregation — one $lookup aggregate per product rather than batched pipeline (pre-existing, flagged iter 1 & 3).

critical_code_review_comments: Backend ProductUpsertRequest + PUT /api/admin/products/{id} accept the exact full-body shape the fixed ProductEditor sends (id-in-body is safely overridden by $set with path id).

Admin category PUT uses update_many on products.category — atomic cascade. Add validates non-empty via 400. Rename validates non-empty new_name via 400.
seed_data_creation: Reused seeded_user + seeded_admin fixtures (session-scoped) from conftest.py. All TEST_-prefixed products/categories cleaned up in test finally blocks.

rca_of_issue: User-reported bug: 'able to update category, But product is not possible to edit — Uncaught Error: styles is not defined' at admin.tsx:532:119 (ProductEditor). ROOT CAUSE (frontend-only, confirmed by main agent): `const makeStyles = (theme) => StyleSheet.create({...})` was declared at module scope AFTER both AdminScreen and ProductEditor function declarations. Under certain Metro HMR / bundler evaluation orders, when ProductEditor rendered during AdminScreen's first paint, it hit a temporal-dead-zone on `makeStyles` (since arrow-function `const` is not hoisted) and threw ReferenceError, blanking the edit UI. FIX APPLIED: moved `makeStyles` declaration to line 21 — above both components. ProductEditor retains its own `const styles = useMemo(() => makeStyles(theme), [theme])`. BACKEND VERIFICATION: PUT /api/admin/products/{id} with the full ProductUpsertRequest body the frontend now sends persists every field and returns 200; create→edit→delete round-trip verified; auth gating unchanged. No backend changes needed and no backend regression introduced.
